record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare KNOCK_OFF: Sableye (3 stars, passive SABLEYE) and Mega Sableye (4 stars, passive MEGA_SABLEYE). The passives are separate mechanisms and are not covered here. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single target, immediate, in this order: (1) compute damage = base by stars + (number of items the target holds right now) x per-item amount by stars (30 + 15 per item at 1 star ... 90 + 30 per item for 3 stars and 100 + 35 per item for 4 stars; the table has five entries); (2) remove every item the target holds from the fight entity (not from its board pokemon: removeItem is called without permanent), which also takes away the item stat bonuses and item-given synergy types and runs removal effects; (3) deal SPECIAL damage equal to the amount computed in step 1. The item count is read before the removal, so the bonus uses the held items; the damage itself is resolved after the removal, so the target's defensive stats are already without those items. The removal happens even when the damage is then blocked (protect, skydiving, magic bounce), and a target with no items takes only the base amount.

targeting.note: No area. The target is chosen by the generic cast pipeline (not traced here).

declaredRaw.label: requested damage (raw) = base + items held x per item

effects.scaling: requested = base[stars-1] + target.items.size x perItem[stars-1], the item count taken at the start of the cast (before removal). perUnitRaw lists the base only; the per-item amounts are 30 (Sableye, 3 stars) and 35 (Mega Sableye, 4 stars). With 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 items: Sableye 90 / 120 / 150 / 180, Mega Sableye 100 / 135 / 170 / 205 requested (the entity item set can hold more than the three board slots only if other effects add items; not examined). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; x critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT), reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite (the Rocky Helmet is one of the removed items, but the reduction check runs after the removal, so the helmet no longer counts).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef) using the target's speDef AFTER the item stats were subtracted, rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The returned takenDamage / death is not used by this ability.

declaredRaw.label: every held item removed from the fight entity

effects.scaling: none (not scaled by stars, AP or crit)
effects.resolution: Requested: remove all items. Applied: for each item in the target's set, removeItem(item) with permanent = false: the item leaves the fight entity's set; its declared stat bonuses are subtracted through applyStat; an item-given synergy type that is not a default type of the unit is deleted together with its tier effects; the item's effects are removed or its OnItemRemovedEffect is run; other OnItemRemovedEffect effects present (from passives, synergies, ...) are also run for each removed item. The board pokemon's own items are not touched (permanent is false), so this is a fight-only removal; whether the items are back for the next fight follows from that and was not traced. The removal is not blocked by protect, skydiving or magic bounce, which only gate the damage step. Whether the delete-while-iterating on the SetSchema skips an item was not traced.

starBehavior.note: Stars index both tables (five entries each; ?? 200 / ?? 60 fallbacks). The listed units are catalog stars 3 and 4, so entries 3 and 4 of each table apply; entries 1, 2 and 5 are not used by the listed units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in this strategy; range comes from the unit (1).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. A second cast on the same target finds no items (unless another effect gave it new ones) and deals only the base amount.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: base 90 / 100 (3 / 4 stars) + 30 / 35 per item held at cast time. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division (with the item bonuses already removed) and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied removal = every item leaves the fight entity, with its stat, type and effect consequences, regardless of whether the damage is blocked.
